thread:
sam: Quick q — when PD routes an alert, where should the eng oncall look for traces/logs/dashboards? We had a page last night but the incident in PD had no trace link and it slowed us down. Is there a canonical handbook section?

maria: Short answer: PD incident should include links if the Grafana alert rule has the right annotations. We rely on annotations: runbook, grafana_url, jaeger. Lots of older rules never got the jaeger/grafana_url annotations.

ben: Example annotation snippet we use in grafana alerts (add to the alert rule template):

```
annotations:
  runbook: "https://handbook.redwood.ai/oncall/playbooks/infra-inference"
  grafana_url: "https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/inference-alerts?orgId=1&panelId=2&var-service=${__alert.labels.service}"
  jaeger: "https://jaeger.redwood.ai/trace/${__alert.labels.trace_id}"
```

maria: Also ensure PD integration maps annotation keys. We map `grafana_url` -> "Investigate" link in the incident. If the annotation key differs, PD won't show it. Ping @devex if your service uses a custom key.

alex: Is there any inventory of which services still need annotations? I can pick up storage-svc.

liam: I started a quick sheet for handoff: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1example — it lists services, alert rules, and whether runbook/grafana/jaeger annotations exist. I'll add storage-svc and mark as assigned to alex.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-4321 created: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-4321 — annotations parsed: none found. :warning:

sam: That bot line is exactly the problem — alert didn't include annotations. Can someone share the grafana rule name so I can open a PR?

maria: Rule name is `inference_latency_high` in `infra` dashboard. Grafana rule link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/rules/infra/inference_latency_high

ben: I'll open a PR to add runbook + grafana_url + jaeger. Also filing a small PD-integration change to map `jaeger` annotation into the incident "Investigate" link so traces appear in the PD UI.

sam: Awesome, thanks Ben. Can we also add a short fallback in the oncall playbook: if no trace link, call out runbook + where to find logs (Datadog/Logging link)? Saves time.

maria: Agreed — playbook section `Initial triage -> locate traces/logs` should list: Grafana rule, Jaeger, Datadog logs, and relevant Kibana queries. I'll update handbook after Ben's PR is merged. :thumbsup:

ben: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config/pull/412 — adds annotations + updates alert template. Please review.

alex: Reviewing now. If everything looks good I'll assign storage-svc changes to myself.

sam: If we don't get the PD mapping changed and rules fixed by tomorrow 10:00, I'll escalate to infra lead so oncall isn't blocked.

liam: Noted. I'll also add a tiny dashboard panel that shows "last_alert_annotations" so it's easier to audit which alerts are missing links.

maria: Thanks all — this should make paging much smoother.
